correctness.rationale: The crossing-degree parity identity reduces the conditioned matching exactly to n! odd-even bijections. Enumerating r disjoint cycle edges gives exact binomial factorial moments. A globally uniform product inequality and binomial inversion bound the simple-chord Poisson(2) total variation by 30 exp(4)/n for n>=4. A noncrossing-component closed-interval witness gives an O(1/n) bound on all non-simple off-giant components, explicitly retaining the 2/n! all-simple exception; coupling proves the joint (K,n-L) limit. Every stated boundary case and the finite n=2 exception are included. The standalone executable verify.py passed 75,108 exact finite checks, including exhaustive unrestricted n<=6 and conditioned n<=8, independently corroborating the crucial finite identities and obstruction but not claiming an infinite proof.

exact_database_or_table.reasoning: The exact connected-count enumeration is covered by these sources; it is explicitly excluded from novelty. The new theorem is not a table re-computation: it controls, jointly and in total variation with finite-size rate, every possible count of components and deficit of the largest crossing component.

originality.rationale: The condition is the already known parity-reversing pairing model, and the sequence of exactly connected diagrams and noncrossing-partition generating function already belong to Blitvic 2014 (also OEIS A390400); those are not new. The particular joint total-variation convergence of the full component count and largest-component deficit to the coupled (1+Poisson(2),Poisson(2)) law with an O(n^-1) rate, plus its explicit high-probability one-giant/simple-isolates certificate, was not stated in the inspected primary sources. Unrestricted Poisson(1) results do not transfer through exponentially rare parity conditioning. Prior exact connected enumerations do determine the connectivity marginal at fixed n, so novelty excludes that finite sequence and does not rest solely on e^-2. Residual risk remains for a hidden stronger asymptotic implied by earlier exact enumerative theory.
residual_risks: Exact c_n count and partition generating functions might yield implicit derivations of the connectivity marginal, which is explicitly excluded from novelty; stronger unlocated exact refinements could also imply the joint TV theorem.
Other historical work on parity-reversing pairings, chord-connected permutations, and monolithic diagrams may contain equivalent component-profile asymptotics under different names.
Only indexed excerpts of the Acan full article were accessible; an equivalent stronger result in an uninspected section cannot be completely ruled out.

value.rationale: The conditioning is an exponentially rare, mathematically canonical Gauss parity constraint in circle graphs. A natural exact object (component count and largest size) exhibits a parameter-doubling change from known unrestricted laws. The result supplies a structural one-giant component certificate, a quantitative joint distribution bound, and a precise comparison with known connected-permutation enumeration. It is not a narrow arbitrary table entry, a relabeled exercise, or an observation of the small-size enumeration alone.
